additional_info.subject: ID0386901-DC/SI-D/FR-[MP / R3 170001705]- Multiple errors CRM:01282000636
additional_info.body:
Hi Florian, good morning. How are you doing?
I'm personally taking over this ticket to support you.
From the errors that we see, it's clear that the fast shutdown process is not done in the group 2. From my experience, it looks like there might be a fault with QA33:
The principle here is that KF13 is constantly sending 12V and only when the QA33 is closed, the converters receive the 12V to perform the fastshutdown. And what we see is that during the converter grouping these 12V are not applied to the converters when requested.
Are you able to troubleshoot this yourself or should I request support from the regional Siemens colleagues?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0386901-DC/SI-D/FR-[MP / R3 170001705]- NoConverters_CGp_DC2 CRM:00315001991
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Mr. Florian Mura from Engie raised this ticket regarding fastshutdown not being performed correctly in ONLY group 2.
From the errors that we see, it's clear that the fast shutdown process is not done in the group 2. From my experience, it looks like there might be a fault with QA33 since all the other groups are working as intended. Please order a new QA33 in case it needs replacement. I would first suggest to swap QA33 with QA34 (for example) and see if it improves.
The principle here is that KF13 is constantly sending 12V and only when the QA33 is closed, the converters receive the 12V to perform the fastshutdown. And what we see is that during the converter grouping these 12V are not applied to the converters when requested.
